scientific_limitations_and_integrity: The proven result is the second-order shape spectrum for fixed area and fixed smooth mean-zero perturbations, plus asymptotics of its exact coefficients as the area increases. No uniform nonlinear shape-remainder claim, global stability theorem, or independent validation is made. The comparison with the 2023 fixed-vector superlevel-set Hessian leaves possible implicit-priority risk.
title: Exact shape Hessian and Poisson spectral-edge transition for Gaussian time–frequency localization
